component: Thunderbird address-book addCard API and transfer callers

quotes.text: nsIAbCard addCard(in nsIAbCard card, [optional] in boolean withNewUID);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The dropCard removal places its storage behavior in addCard(card, withNewUID). The optional flag requests a fresh UID; the base retains the input UID when the flag is omitted or false. Drag/drop copy passes true, while drag move omits it. The contact panel keeps its separate new-UID-before-delete policy when changing books. Preserve that caller distinction instead of deriving identity from the word move alone. Existing CardDAV copy/move tests check changed versus retained UID and later destination metadata; synchronous local return does not establish remote completion.
title: withNewUID selects contact identity, and each transfer caller chooses the policy
